capabilities: Browse components, xdbjs, and forms Feishu bitable libraries in a tabbed card view
Download attachment files from bitable records into configured vault folders
Resolve wiki links and fetch tenant_access_tokens using Feishu app credentials
Handle duplicate files with skip, rename, or overwrite choices
Sync download paths from the components and form-flow plugins
disambiguation: Not a general file downloader; it only fetches attachments from the three built-in Feishu libraries (components, xdbjs, forms).
extras: Desktop-only (isDesktopOnly = true), requires Obsidian 1.11.0 or later. Credentials are stored locally in plugin settings. Manual and BRAT installation only; no community plugin store listing mentioned.
problem: Obsidian has no way to browse Feishu wiki bitable records or pull their attachment files into vault folders.

relations.evidence: The sync button beside each path can copy values from other installed and enabled plugins

requires.name: Feishu App ID and App Secret

summary: Feishu integration that browses wiki bitable libraries and downloads their attachment files into configured folders in the vault.
